messages:
maya: Quick sync thread 1: planning a micro-webinar + launch posts that tie into the free-credit onboarding experiment. Need to decide: gating mechanics, two headline angles for socials, which 3 prompt templates go in the starter pack, and analytics events. Can we land this in 20m?
jon: Yep. My items: webinar runtime (40min + Q&A), CTA to claim credits, and post-event nurture cadence. Proposing Tue 11am PT.
li: Tue 11am PT ok. For gating: prefer email registration + optional token to reduce churn. If token present we mark lead as "claimable" but only issue final credits after attendance.
sam: I sketched 2 headline families: Angle 1 (benchmarks): "See how teams cut inference cost by 3x—live demo + credits". Angle 2 (getting started): "Starter prompts + free credits to ship your first feature". Where to run each?
oscar: LinkedIn = benchmarks, developer channels (X, HackerNews) = starter prompts. Also throw the testimonial line into the LinkedIn copy as anonymized stat. Add UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_campaign=cruise_launch_v1.
maya: Sam, can you drop both copies + one image suggestion each into Notion under /marketing/webinars? Also include short alt text for accessibility.
sam: Done. I added three starter prompts: "quick-summary", "rewrite-for-exec", and "bug-to-testcase". Sample: `prompt: "Convert this customer note into a 2-sentence exec summary"`.
li: Routing rules proposal: attendees -> cookie `webinar_cruise=1`; if credited && usage>=1 within 7d -> tag sales:hot. Registrants who didn't attend -> drip 4 emails over 10 days with sample prompts.
jon: Measurement: primary KPI = 7-day meaningful usage (>=3 API calls). Secondary: webinar->signup rate. Need new event `credit_claimed_webinar` and property `credit_balance_after_claim`.
oscar: I'll add `credit_claimed_webinar` to analytics and push a dashboard tile. Also setting an alert if credit usage spikes > $5000/day from the campaign.
maya: Credit issuance: proposal from product ops: 30 credits on signup, +70 after attendance + 1st API call. Prevents churny signups. Thoughts?
li: I like staggered issuance. Backend needs `/credits/claim` endpoint idempotent and rate-limited. Add TTL of 14 days for pending claims.
sam: Also recommend including a short onboarding flow in the post-claim modal with the three starter prompts and a one-click "run sample" to generate immediate output. That should help early activation.
oscar: Agree. We'll track a new funnel event `ran_sample_prompt` and correlate to activation.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Cruise Control: Inference Launch" Tue 11:00 PT. Invitees: maya, jon, li, sam, oscar.
jon: Promo schedule: 12d out (announcement), 6d (benchmark highlight), 2d (starter prompts), day-of, post-webinar follow-ups x2. Add audience tags: infra engineers, ML platform, product.
maya: Design needs to review landing 10am tomorrow. Jon, finalize the demo bullets: infra dashboard + prompt walkthrough. Sam to draft demo scripts.
sam: Will post demo bullets and a 3-slide backup for the benchmark case.
li: Final note: ensure landing page writes cohort cookie from utm_campaign and that the claim button POSTs to `/api/credits/claim?source=webinar_cruise`.
oscar: Filing engineering ticket and tagging eng-oncall.
maya: Great. Action list: Sam - Notion + demo bullets; Oscar - analytics + JIRA ticket; Li - routing doc; Jon - final agenda; Design review 10am tomorrow. Back here after design sign-off. :sparkles:
